استصدروا (form X)
# اِسْتَصْدَرُوا (istaṣdarū) /is.tasˤ.da.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
# اُسْتُصْدِرُوا (ustuṣdirū) /us.tusˤ.di.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
# اِسْتَصْدِرُوا (istaṣdirū) /is.tasˤ.di.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَصْدَرَ (istaṣdara)
